author: Akien
prose:
(Akien, 2026-09-11, across one conversation — his words, in order.)

"/home/akien/dev/src/hermes-agent -- this is reported to be on par with you. so i am thinking that as today is friday, tomorrow we're see if we can build you an assistant. one who also learns. a peer not a replacement. so you should check it out before i install it. i phrase it that way because we might wind up forking the repo, or just incorporating it's patterns, not sure yet. but i didn't want to install it until you'd taken a deep look."

"My friend, for a change you are in fact thinking like me. So we're still blueskying... but that is what i was going to propose, a hermes device. and i was thinking to hook it to our Apple M1 32G called hex.local. maybe even eventually thru our inference proxy. then it's both a peer to you, who could also be an antagonist for some of these things. and be inspected live as we go. forking was a thinking centered about adding the kind of logging we have, so we can see more of what happens inside."

"we have one box who i consider to be useful for inference jobs other than at night. that's Hex. akienyoga9i is our fastest compute other than the apple, and it would need 5 to 10 minute timeouts and can mostly be relied on to be available only between midnight and 7pm. that would be fine for things like bulk reading, but not for hermes. only local resource for hermes is the apple. but we have 3 compute needs: 1 inference, hex. 2 database. 3 builder instances and/or other agents. --- but then we have to actualy build out multiple agents on one cross host shared bus. which i'd prefer to wait on. i'd rather bring up hermes here with you. then one in the foreground and one in the background. if we can make that go. now: embeddings. we have an embeddings generator which uses graph trees and learns as it goes."

"yeah, i'm trying to keep everything off of hex i can. so that it's paltry 32gb won't be a problem. database is here on akiendelllinux with you, and maybe hermes. the other point i can make here, if you can complete those 3 before we run outta room for the day. we're at 90%. i think it'll be tight. but i'd say we're ready to move to both intentions and ticketing already. the ais rely on resubmission! that's news to me. well, i have found that slightly different wording is more effective anyway"
